description: Source code for the RankingMetrics class in Apache Spark's MLlib evaluation module, providing ranking evaluation metrics such as precision, NDCG, and MAP.

classes.name: RankingMetrics
classes.description: Evaluator for ranking algorithms, providing metrics like precision, NDCG, and MAP at various cutoff points.

methods.name: precisionAt
methods.description: Calculates the average precision at a specified rank position k.

methods.name: meanAveragePrecision
methods.description: Calculates the mean average precision (MAP) over all queries.

methods.name: meanAveragePrecisionAt
methods.description: Calculates the MAP at a specific rank position k.

methods.name: ndcgAt
methods.description: Calculates the average NDCG at a specified rank position k.

methods.name: recallAt
methods.description: Calculates the average recall at a specified rank position k.

methods.name: countRelevantItemRatio
methods.description: Helper method to compute relevant item ratio at rank k.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method for creating RankingMetrics instances from JavaRDD, for Java interoperability.
